premise: A farm boy with no talent for cultivation at all, the worst in his village. One day he finds a ring with the soul of an ancient master inside.

bible.title: The Master's Ring
bible.era: Ancient Jade Province: wooden villages, spiritual herbs, and soaring swords

extraordinary.reach: Cultivators can shatter mountains and live for thousands of years.
The souls of deceased masters can latch onto relics to escape physical decay.

peoples.name: Humans
peoples.culture: A society deeply divided between the mortal farmers who toil in the dirt and the immortal cultivators who command the heavens.

creatures.name: Spitfire Wolf
creatures.description: A wolf with embers trailing from its fur, drawn to areas rich in fire Qi.

nature: Qi density varies by region, heavily affecting how fast a cultivator can recover energy.

rungs.name: Body Tempering
rungs.description: Strengthening the flesh and bones to endure spiritual energy.

rungs.name: Qi Condensation
rungs.description: Drawing external Qi into the body to pool in the dantian.

rungs.name: Foundation Establishment
rungs.description: Solidifying spiritual energy into a liquid sea of Qi.

rungs.name: Core Formation
rungs.description: Condensing the liquid Qi into a solid golden core of immense power.

rungs.name: Nascent Soul
rungs.description: Nurturing an immortal spirit within, capable of surviving physical death.

travel.description: Cultivators travel by flying swords or spiritual beasts; mortals travel slowly on foot or by ox cart.

medicine.healing: Mortal herbs heal flesh wounds, while spirit pills can repair damaged meridians and seal broken bones instantly.

laws.text: Mortals must pay an annual tribute of spirit stones to the local Iron Mountain Sect.

norms: Treating a mortal with mercy is seen as a sign of weakness by orthodox sects.

rules.text: Only those who open their meridian channels can manipulate spiritual Qi.
A soul bound to an artifact cannot wander far from its physical vessel.
A weak spiritual root can be refined and elevated through rare spiritual medicines.

mysteries.question: Who betrayed Master Mo and sealed him within the ring?
mysteries.answer: His chief disciple, who is now the Grand Elder of the Iron Mountain Sect.
clues: A broken insignia of the Iron Mountain Sect engraved inside the master's soul space.
Master Mo's violent reaction when he hears the name of the local sect.

player.name: Chen Xiao
player.description: A stubborn boy of humble origins, used to hard labor and mockery.
player.appearance: Leathers, coarse cotton shirt, scruffy dark hair, and a determined gaze despite his lean frame.

traits.name: Clogged Meridians
traits.description: Your internal channels are blocked, making it incredibly difficult to absorb spiritual Qi.

talents.name: Cultivation Block
talents.covers: Refining spiritual Qi into your dantian.

powers.name: Soul Communion
powers.description: Allows you to communicate telepathically with Master Mo inside the ring and peer into his mental space.
limits: Requires wearing or holding the bound ring.

items.name: Rusted Copper Ring
items.description: A heavy, pitted ring that houses the soul of Master Mo.

items.name: Iron Shovel
items.description: A worn tool used for tilling the tough earth of the fields.

backstory.text: You were born to simple farmers in Stonefalls Village.
At the annual testing, your spiritual roots were declared 'trash-grade', cementing your status as the worst prospect in the village.

village-chief.name: Chief Wu
village-chief.description: A severe elder with deep frown lines and a stooped back, burdened by the village's debts.
village-chief.appearance: Grey hair tied in a tight bun, wearing rough-spun hemp robes.

father-chen.name: Chen Ding
father-chen.description: A loving but deeply exhausted farmer who has spent his entire life working the rocky soil of the village.
father-chen.appearance: Leathery, sun-bronzed skin, thick calloused hands, and kind, tired eyes.

ancient-master.name: Master Mo
ancient-master.description: An ethereal soul projection residing inside a rusted copper ring, sharp-tongued and proud.
ancient-master.appearance: A faint, semi-translucent figure of a middle-aged man with sharp features and floating long hair.

traits.name: Disembodied
traits.description: Has no physical body and cannot interact directly with physical objects.

agenda.goal: Rebuild his physical body and take revenge on his treacherous disciples.
agenda.method: Guide the player to become a powerful cultivator so he has an ally.

secrets: Master Mo was poisoned and betrayed by the current Sect Master of the Iron Mountain Sect.

stonefalls-mortals.name: Stonefalls Villagers
stonefalls-mortals.description: Hardy, superstitious farmers who simply wish to survive the winter and avoid the anger of the sects.
stonefalls-mortals.goal: Pay the sect tribute on time.
stonefalls-mortals.methods: Harsh rationing and exhausting farm labor.
stonefalls-mortals.strength: Dozens of simple, unarmed mortal laborers.

iron-mountain-sect.name: Iron Mountain Sect
iron-mountain-sect.description: A minor cultivation sect that rules the local territory with an iron fist, demanding resources from nearby villages.
iron-mountain-sect.goal: Acquire more spirit stones to expand their influence.
iron-mountain-sect.strength: Dozens of Qi Condensation disciples and a Foundation Establishment Sect Master.
secrets: The Sect Master is dying of a poisoned meridian and is desperate for a cure.

stonefalls-village.name: Stonefalls Village
stonefalls-village.description: A quiet agrarian community built from gray river stones and timber, nestled at the base of the mountains.

southern-fields.name: The Southern Fields
southern-fields.description: Terraced plots of coarse earth where the villagers grow low-grade spiritual grain.

whispering-hills.name: The Whispering Hills
whispering-hills.description: Lush, rolling hills surrounding the village, home to wild herbs and dangerous spirit beasts.

fact-1.text: You have the worst spiritual root in the entire village.

fact-2.text: The Iron Mountain Sect demands tribute every year.

fact-3.text: The copper ring you found contains a living soul.

tribute-threat.title: Sect Tribute
tribute-threat.stakes: The village must pay the tribute, or the sect will drag away the young mortals as forced laborers.

master-guidance.title: A Master's Legacy
master-guidance.stakes: The player must overcome their trash-tier spiritual root to step onto the path of immortality.

tribute-collection.name: The Iron Mountain Sect Tribute Collection
steps: Sect heralds declare the tribute total.
Villagers struggle to gather enough spiritual grain.
Ruthless collectors arrive in the village to claim grain or take hostages.

event-1.title: The Iron Mountain Sect Tribute Collection: Sect heralds declare the tribute total.

positions: Chen Xiao is kneeling in the dirt, holding the glowing ring
Chen Ding is resting under the shade of the withered tree
scene.ended_on: The cold voice inside your head fades into a demanding silence as the copper ring pulses in your hand.

state.summary: You are a simple farm boy with zero talent for cultivation, the laughingstock of your village. Everything changes when you dig up a strange copper ring containing the proud soul of an ancient, betrayed master.

scenes.narration:
Your iron shovel strikes a hard object in the dry earth of the Southern Fields, ringing out with a sharp metallic clink. Wiping sweat from your brow under the pale dawn sky, you kneel and brush away the coarse red soil to reveal a heavy, rusted copper ring. In the crevices of its pitted surface, a faint, warm amber light begins to throb with the rhythmic beat of a silent heart.

Beyond the terraced plots of low-grade spiritual grain, the jagged peaks of the Iron Mountain Sect loom in the morning mist, a constant reminder of the tribute your village cannot pay. Under the shade of a nearby withered tree, your father, Chen Ding, rests his aching back, his sun-bronzed face lined with exhaustion. He is too tired to notice your discovery.

As your fingers brush the warm metal, a voice resonates directly inside your head, cold, sharp, and incredibly proud. *'A trash-grade spiritual root, and completely clogged meridians? What a pathetic mortal to wake me from my slumber.'* The ring pulses brighter, waiting for your response.

choices: Put the glowing ring on and speak to the voice in your head
Hide the glowing ring in your pocket before your father notices
Ask Father if the village has enough spirit stones for the tribute
